subject.title: feat: Plugin API for TUI footer status contributions (registerStatusProvider)

question: Should OpenClaw accept a public PluginStatusProvider/registerStatusProvider SDK seam for TUI/status contributions now, and what method name, return shape, provider multiplicity, and render boundary should the linked implementation PR use?
rationale: This crosses public Plugin SDK compatibility and TUI product behavior, so automation can verify the gap but should not choose the long-term API contract.

options.title: Approve API-only seam
options.body: Refresh the linked implementation PR and land the registry/API contract while keeping visible footer rendering under the broader footer tracker.

options.title: Derive API from footer design
options.body: Pause the linked implementation PR until ordering, truncation, theming, and placement are decided in the broader footer customization tracker.

options.title: Reject persistent footer extension
options.body: Close this direction and keep /status, /usage, logs, and plugin-owned command surfaces as the supported status visibility paths.

recommendation.title: Approve API-only seam
recommendation.body: Refresh the linked implementation PR and land the registry/API contract while keeping visible footer rendering under the broader footer tracker.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily public SDK and product/API direction, and current-main history ties this person to both plugin registry surfaces and TUI paths.
